missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ладонь' is a soft-sign feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Тёплая' is the agreeing feminine adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ладонь' is the accusative direct object of 'показал', unchanged from the nominative as a soft-sign feminine. 'Свою' agrees, and 'мне' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На ладони' uses the prepositional form 'ладони' after 'на'. The soft-sign feminine takes the ending '-и' to describe where something is.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Ладони' is the genitive singular after 'нет'. The soft-sign feminine ending '-и' marks absence, and 'свободной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Ладонью' is the instrumental form showing the instrument of the action. Soft-sign feminines take the ending '-ью' in the instrumental singular.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В ладони' uses the prepositional form 'ладони' after 'в' to express where the coin is held. The soft-sign feminine ending is '-и'.

missions.phrase: Я дал ребёнку конфету в ладонь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Ладонь' is accusative after 'в', marking motion into the palm. As a soft-sign feminine it keeps the nominative form, and 'ребёнку' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Ладони' is the accusative plural after 'на', the object of the doctor's gaze. 'Мои' agrees in the plural with this soft-sign feminine noun.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Ладони' is the nominative plural subject of 'стали'. 'Холодными' is the instrumental predicate adjective used after the verb 'стать'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Ладонями' is the instrumental plural showing the means of covering. The soft-sign feminine takes the ending '-ями' in this useful gesture description.
